title: A small payment with a cost
hook: Two stated cases: explore a stated participation cost alongside a reward.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How a stated participation cost alongside a reward affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Gain, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare a stated participation cost alongside a reward in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Keeping a toy option yields 10. Switching yields 12 and costs 3. What is the gain from switching?
